One man turned five thousand rupees into forty six thousand crore. And the biggest part came after he turned fifty five.
Nineteen eighty five. Rakesh Jhunjhunwala, a young chartered accountant, starts with five thousand rupees. The Sensex is at one fifty.
In two thousand two, he starts buying Titan. Watches, and Tanishq jewellery. A company few people believed in.
His cost? Under five rupees a share, in today's terms. Today, over four thousand six hundred. More than nine hundred times.
He kept that bet for twenty years. His family still owns Titan shares worth about twenty two thousand crore.
The twist? His portfolio went from eight thousand crore in twenty twenty, to thirty thousand crore by twenty twenty two.
The lesson? He started as a trader. But the real fortune came from one thing. Time.
